project.title: Source-backed advisory journal preview
project.goal: Use actual private ledger snapshots for shared Rust manual validation

action.journal_preview.description: Collect trusted current ledger facts and return advisory exact manual preview

preconditions: Strict bounded canonical input;advisory explicit horizon;exact recognized current snapshot and compiled rule metadata.
postconditions: Deterministic advisory Validation or refusal;private copies explicitly closed/deleted;no source data effects or writer authority.

authorization.rationale: No facts/privileges accepted from input;preview grants no authority.

atomicity.rationale: Source never opened through SQLite;private recovery cleaned before response.

concurrency.rationale: Existing stable captured image and one private read connection;no live reservation.

idempotency.rationale: Read-only repeat deterministic on unchanged source/input.

action.journal_preview.behavior: Collect actual strict source facts,invoke compiled pure manual validation,return advisory result after cleanup.

boundary.responsibility: Bounded canonical input/compiled metadata/current snapshot fact collection and cleanup
boundary.rationale: A usable shared engine must evaluate actual captured source state.
excludes: Writer authority,mutation,dry-run insert,legal/audit integrity certification and product server/client wiring

scenario.normal.description: Actual source facts and exact native outcomes agree with independent expectations/ordinary legacy behavior.

scenario.given: Synthetic full canonical ledger,input and explicit horizon.
scenario.when: Run real CLI and source-backed native service.
scenario.then: Actual source facts and exact native outcomes agree with independent expectations/ordinary legacy behavior.

scenario.refusal.description: Malformed input/source/schema/facts/rule metadata refuse with correct transport/exit and cleanup.

scenario.given: Synthetic full canonical ledger,input and explicit horizon.
scenario.when: Run real CLI and source-backed native service.
scenario.then: Malformed input/source/schema/facts/rule metadata refuse with correct transport/exit and cleanup.

scenario.preservation.description: Original file bytes/typed cells remain unchanged;repeat outputs stable and private dirs empty.

scenario.when: Run real CLI and source-backed native service.
scenario.then: Original file bytes/typed cells remain unchanged;repeat outputs stable and private dirs empty.

scenario.concurrent.description: Stable snapshot or bounded source_changed refusal while source files change.

scenario.given: A synthetic source with a live writer or replaced sidecar.
scenario.then: A coherent captured image or explicit bounded refusal;no mixed facts or original writes.
